info.title: Amrutam Backend API
info.description: Phase 4: identity/MFA, discovery, availability, booking, encrypted clinical records, prescription versions, internal fake payments, durable jobs and admin audit/analytics. No real payment or email provider is configured.

post.description: Public patient registration only. Same generic response for existing accounts. Encrypted setup delivery is queued; no email provider is configured.

get.description: All roles with completed MFA. Name is a case-insensitive literal substring; specialty is case-insensitive exact match. availableFrom/availableTo must both be supplied and contain a whole future open unoccupied slot. Explicit RFC3339 offsets; UTC output. Stable name/id order, bounded offset pagination. Only public directory fields are cached for 30s with a transactional DB revision; time-filtered discovery bypasses cache. Cache errors fall back to PostgreSQL; security rate-limit errors still fail closed.

get.description: Authenticated users see future open unoccupied slots of active doctors. The owning doctor sees all their slots including blocked/occupied/history. from/to contain a whole slot, bounds are inclusive; stable startsAt/id order. Responses are live, not cached.

post.description: Owning doctor only. Future [startsAt,endsAt) slots; adjacency allowed, overlap forbidden even for blocked slots. Input requires RFC3339 UTC or numeric offset with seconds and optional millisecond precision. timeZone is a validated IANA presentation hint; the explicit offset defines the instant. No recurrence or local-time inference.

post.description: Active MFA-authenticated patient only; patient identity comes from the access token, never the body. Locks and revalidates the slot in PostgreSQL; exactly one non-cancelled consultation can occupy it. Consultation, successful audit, encrypted idempotency result and one logical outbox record commit atomically. Booking/cancellation limits allow 120 requests per actor/minute; Redis never owns slots. No payment or external network call occurs inside this transaction.

Scheduled consultations strictly before slot start only; patient reason patient_request, doctor reason doctor_unavailable, admin any defined code. Locks slot before consultation, releases occupancy atomically and emits one cancellation outbox record. Identical same-key retry replays; a different key against cancelled/started/completed state returns 409.
